# 上游发布自动化 / Upstream publishing automation

本拼车版不包含上游发布、镜像推送、分支推送或 CLA 写入工作流。保留的验证工作流默认权限只读。
The carpool edition excludes upstream release, image publishing, branch pushing and CLA-write workflows. Retained validation workflows use read-only permissions.

部署需仓库所有者单独配置和授权；发布源码不是生产部署授权。
Deployment requires separate owner configuration and authorization; publishing source is not permission to deploy production.
